implementation: Catalog uses existing Bench Map modules, binding types and anchors; no duplicate registry.
Search/filter pattern reuses local Visual Field Library approach.
Context windows invoke existing A0OrientationMapView.openNode; exact Bench href match first, explicit source-context matches otherwise general bench context.
Existing rendered SVG/canvas is cloned/downsampled into frozen previews; no source engine advanced or loaded. Missing graphics show labelled group sketches.
Menu columns adapt by group and can be overridden to 2,3,4; narrow viewports use 2 then 1 column. This never changes mathematical source grids.
contextBoundaries: Body route -> existing body context, native face -> existing blue context, Family-role -> existing families context are navigational context only, not new carrier identities.
All other unresolved individual matches show general Bench context; no fabricated fine-grained graph links.
Preview images are moments, not live telemetry. Generic group sketches are not source screenshots.
The new UI has no browser/WebGL acceptance in this turn. Earlier Owner reports apply to earlier views only.
priorReceipts: Dated source hashes remain historical snapshots; this receipt describes the current catalog extension.
